title: JANUS SkayLUCIGate
purpose: Adapt evidence-management semantics from operator-supplied JANUS Blind Eye/TMOS and Yaks Gate IR into a fail-closed astronomical LUCI scene/temporal gate.

physical_separation.blind_eye_tmos: algorithmic inspiration only; not an astronomical near-IR detector model
physical_separation.yaks_ir: 38-kHz local IR signalling is not LUCI astronomy

security.rule: SHA256 identity plus safe macros only

admitted_claim: On the real 2F-F receipt, SkayLUCIGate preserves 41/42 sensitivity-qualified source coverage, keeps one source unresolved, and classifies the single Br_gamma candidate as a bracketed one-frame IR event rather than a persistent counterpart.
not_admitted: one-frame Br_gamma event is not a confirmed persistent counterpart
event is not established as astrophysical rather than detector/background artifact
TMOS/PIR and 38-kHz Yaks IR do not simulate LUCI response
Palomar-epoch counterfactual LUCI scene is not physically reconstructed in v0.1

next_gate.name: JANUS-SKAY-LUCI-GATE-v0.2-RAW-FITS-SCENE
next_gate.goal: Add raw-FITS before/candidate/after patch and difference-image scene analysis; then add calibrated Palomar->LUCI forward modelling.
